newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-ZELIC NOT TO JOIN RAPID VIENNA AFTER ALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZELIC NOT TO JOIN RAPID VIENNA AFTER ALL.

text.p: Australian midfielder Ned Zelic on Friday decided not to join Austrian first division club Rapid Vienna on loan from Auxerre after all.
"Everything had already been arranged with Zelic. The contract with Auxerre was also already settled," said disappointed Rapid manager Stefan Ebner.
On Thursday, Ebner said Zelic had joined the 1996 European Cup Winners' Cup finalists for at least one year.
Zelic, 26, who joined Auxerre a year ago after playing for Borussia Dortmund, England's Queens Park Rangers and Eintracht Frankfurt, flew back to France on Friday.
